```lean
theorem T (a b c : Nat) : a - b - c = a - (b + c) := by
  by_cases h : b + c ≤ a
  · -- case b + c ≤ a
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.le_iff_exists_add.1 h
    -- a = (b + c) + k
    calc
      a - b - c = ((b + c) + k) - b - c := by rfl
      _ = (c + k) - c := by
        rw [add_assoc]
        rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
      _ = k := by rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
      _ = a - (b + c) := by rfl
  · -- case a < b + c
    have h0 : a - (b + c) = 0 := by
      apply Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le.mpr
      exact Nat.le_of_lt h
    have h1 : (a - b) - c = 0 := by
      have : (a - b) < c := by
        exact (Nat.sub_lt_iff_lt_add.mpr h)
      apply Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le.mpr
      exact Nat.le_of_lt this
    simp [h0, h1]
```

```lean
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h

    | succ c ih => simp [Nat.add_succ]; exact ih
  rw [this]
  -- now show (b + c) - c = b

  | zero => simp [Nat.add_zero]
```

```lean
  -- (a - (a - b)) + (a - b) = a because (a - b) ≤ a
  have h1 : (a - (a - b)) + (a - b) = a := Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.sub_le a b)
  -- b + (a - b) = a because b ≤ a
  have h2 : b + (a - b) = a := Nat.sub_add_cancel h
  -- cancel the right addend (a - b) from both sides
  have hsum : (a - (a - b)) + (a - b) = b + (a - b) := h1.trans h2.symm
  exact Nat.add_right_cancel hsum
```
